references.text: Listen to the named men who were to help Moses and Aaron with the census, as verse 17 refers to.
Aaron and his descendants are mentioned, showing how Aaron was chosen together with Moses to lead the people.
The same tribal princes who were named in chapter 1 brought offerings, confirming their appointment by name.
The names of the tribal princes were written on the staffs, parallel to how they were named for service.
The heads of families were registered by name, a similar practice to the census under Moses.
The Lord calls by name, the same expression used for the chosen leaders in Israel.
